secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (browser-safe, same value as SUPABASE_URL). Find it in Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key (browser-safe). Find it in Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys → anon public.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (server-side, same value as VITE_SUPABASE_URL). Find it in Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role secret key (server-side, privileged). Find it in Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys → service_role.

secrets.name: VITE_PROFESSOR_VERIFICATION_CODE
secrets.description: 6-digit instructor verification PIN entered by professors at login. Set to any 6-digit code you want instructors to use.
